result: Momentum, not reversal, at 2–4 week horizons: the pre-registered 28-day quintile portfolio has Sharpe 0.96 (in-sample 0.72, out-of-sample 1.25 with t = 2.1) and 28% a year, but with 31% volatility, a 34% drawdown, 41x annual turnover across a 100-name universe, and a deflated Sharpe of 0.31 after the 8 variants searched. Reversal variants lose at every horizon. A candidate for a separate, larger-capacity book; not in the bot.
